features.Visuals.ClearESP = function()
	for vertex in pairs(features.Visuals.FuryTimers) do
		features.Visuals.ClearFuryTimer(vertex)
	end

	for _, particle in pairs(flyteBBState.ESPLabels) do
		features.Visuals.DestroyLabel(particle)
	end

	table.clear(flyteBBState.ESPLabels)

	for _, particle in pairs(flyteBBState.ESPConnections) do
		if particle then
			particle:Disconnect()
		end
	end

	table.clear(flyteBBState.ESPConnections)

	for vertex, particle in pairs(flyteBBState.AbilityUses) do
		if particle.Ability == "Slashes of Fury" then
			features.Visuals.ClearFury(particle)
			flyteBBState.AbilityUses[vertex] = nil
		end
	end

	local radians = workspace
	local success2 = radians.FindFirstChild

	for _, existingPlayer in pairs({ workspace:FindFirstChild("Alive"), success2(radians, "Dead") }) do
		if existingPlayer then
			for _, propertyName in existingPlayer:GetDescendants() do
				if propertyName.Name == "Ability_ESP" and propertyName:IsA("BillboardGui") then
					propertyName:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for _, existingPlayer in playersService:GetPlayers() do
		local model = existingPlayer.Character

		if model then
			for _, propertyName in model:GetDescendants() do
				if propertyName.Name == "Ability_ESP" and propertyName:IsA("BillboardGui") then
					propertyName:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

features.Visuals.Toggle = function()
	if not flags.AbilityESPEnabled and not flags.AbilityESPShowNames then
		features.Visuals.ClearESP()
		return
	end

	if not flags.AbilityESPEnabled then
		for vertex in pairs(features.Visuals.FuryTimers) do
			features.Visuals.ClearFuryTimer(vertex)
		end

		for vertex, particle in pairs(flyteBBState.AbilityUses) do
			if particle.Ability == "Slashes of Fury" then
				features.Visuals.ClearFury(particle)
				flyteBBState.AbilityUses[vertex] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	features.Visuals.RefreshESP()
end

features.Visuals.HideDuration = function(line)
	if not line.DurationHolder.Visible or line.DurationTween then
		return
	end
	local topTween = tweenService:Create(line.DurationHolder, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { GroupTransparency = 1 })
	line.DurationTween = topTween

	topTween.Completed:Once(function(value2)
			if value2 == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and line.DurationTween == topTween then
				line.DurationHolder.Visible = false
				line.DurationHolder.GroupTransparency = 0
				line.Duration.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
				line.Duration.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
				line.DurationTween = nil
			end
		end)

	topTween:Play()
end

features.Visuals.SetCooldownText = function(line, secondVector)
	if line.CooldownTextShown == secondVector then
		return
	end
	line.CooldownTextShown = secondVector

	if line.CooldownTextTween then
		line.CooldownTextTween:Cancel()
	end

	if secondVector then
		line.CooldownText.Visible = true
	end

	local topTween = tweenService:Create(line.CooldownText, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { TextTransparency = secondVector and 0 or 1, TextStrokeTransparency = secondVector and 0.05 or 1 })
	line.CooldownTextTween = topTween

	topTween.Completed:Once(function(value2)
			if value2 ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Completed or line.CooldownTextTween ~= topTween then
				return
			end

			if not secondVector then
				line.CooldownText.Visible = false
			end

			line.CooldownTextTween = nil
		end)

	topTween:Play()
end

features.Visuals.FormatAbilityTime = function(line)
	local radians = 10
	local difference = math.ceil(line * 10) / radians
	return "(" .. ((difference == math.floor(difference) and tostring(math.floor(difference)) or string.format("%.1f", difference)) .. "s") .. ")"
end

features.Visuals.GetCooldownDuration = function(line, object, descendant)
	local lines = features.Visuals.AbilityData[object] or {}
	local difference = math.max((tonumber(lines.cooldown) or 0) - (tonumber(lines.cooldownReductionPerUpgrade) or 0) * (descendant - 1), 0)
	local openError

	if workspace:GetAttribute("CurrentlySelectedMode") == "Fates" then
		if line:GetAttribute("Fates_DecreasedAbilityCooldown") then
			openError = difference * 0.7
		elseif line:GetAttribute("Fates_IncreasedAbilityCooldown") then
			openError = difference * 1.4285714285714286
		else
			openError = difference
		end
	else
		openError = difference
	end

	return openError
end

features.Visuals.IsAbilityAnimation = function(line, object)
	local chunk = object.Animation
	chunk = chunk and chunk.AnimationId:match("%d+")
	if not chunk then
		return false
	end
	local lines = features.Visuals.AbilityAnimations[line]

	if not lines then
		local model = localPlayer.Character
		model = model and model:FindFirstChild("Abilities")
		local radians = model and model:FindFirstChild(line) or replicatedStorage.Shared.Abilities:FindFirstChild(line)
		if not radians then
			return false
		end
		lines = {}

		for _, existingPlayer in radians:GetDescendants() do
			if existingPlayer:IsA("Animation") then
				local targetName = existingPlayer.AnimationId:match("%d+")

				if targetName then
					lines[targetName] = true
				end
			end
		end

		if not next(lines) then
			return false
		end
		features.Visuals.AbilityAnimations[line] = lines
	end

	return lines[chunk] == true
end

features.Visuals.SetCooldown = function(line, object, descendant, radius)
	local index51 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local difference = math.max(tonumber(line:GetAttribute("CooldownExpiration")) or 0, tonumber(object:GetAttribute("CooldownExpiration")) or 0)
	local openError

	if radius > 0 then
		local step = math.max(tonumber(line:GetAttribute("AbilityDurationStart")) or 0, tonumber(object:GetAttribute("AbilityDurationStart")) or 0)

		if step <= 0 or step > index51 or index51 - step > radius then
			step = index51
		end

		openError = math.max(difference, step + radius)
	else
		if difference <= index51 then
			return index51
		end
		openError = difference
	end

	flyteBBState.AbilityCooldowns[line] = { Ability = descendant, Duration = radius > 0 and radius or openError - index51, Ends = openError }
	return index51
end

features.Visuals.TrackCooldown = function(line, object, descendant)
	local hitPlayer = playersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(line)
	if not hitPlayer or hitPlayer == localPlayer or line.Parent ~= smallest then
		return
	end

	if not object then
		object, descendant = features.Visuals.GetInfo(hitPlayer, line)
	end

	if not object then
		return
	end
	local radians = features.Visuals.GetCooldownDuration(hitPlayer, object, descendant)

	if object == nil then
		features.Detection.TrackAbilityUse(hitPlayer, line, object, descendant + 1, radians)
	end

	local angleRadians = features.Visuals.SetCooldown(hitPlayer, line, object, radians)

	if object == "Dash" then
		flyteBBState.AbilityActive[hitPlayer] = { Ability = object, Start = angleRadians, Duration = 0.2, Ends = angleRadians + 0.2 }
	end
end

features.Visuals.NativeNameVisible = function(line, object)
	line = line and line:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not line or not object or line.DisplayDistanceType == Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None then
		return false
	end

	if line.DisplayDistanceType == Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.Viewer then
		line = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or line
	end

	local index40 = line.NameDisplayDistance
	return index40 > 0 and (primaryPart.CFrame.Position - object.Position).Magnitude <= index40
end

features.Visuals.RefreshPlayer = function(line, object)
	local radians = features.Visuals.GetESPCharacter(line)
	local angleRadians = flyteBBState.ESPLabels[line]
	local track = features.Visuals.GetESPAdornee(radians)

	if not line.Parent or not radians or not track then
		features.Visuals.DestroyLabel(angleRadians)
		flyteBBState.ESPLabels[line] = nil
		return
	end

	if not angleRadians or angleRadians.Character ~= radians or not angleRadians.Billboard.Parent or angleRadians.Billboard.Adornee ~= track then
		features.Visuals.AddLabel(line, radians)
		angleRadians = flyteBBState.ESPLabels[line]
	end

	angleRadians.Character = radians
	local scalar = nil
	local result67 = nil
	local vertexCount = nil
	local steering = nil
	local major = nil
	local netStart = nil
	local byte = nil
	local result68 = nil

	if flags.AbilityESPEnabled then
		vertexCount, byte, steering, major, result67, result68, netStart, scalar = features.Visuals.GetInfo(line, radians, object)
	end

	local cell = radians.Parent == smallest

	if not cell then
		flyteBBState.AbilityActive[line] = nil
		flyteBBState.AbilityCooldowns[line] = nil
		local net = flyteBBState.AbilityUses[line]

		if net then
			if net.Ability == "Slashes of Fury" then
				features.Visuals.ClearFury(net)
				flyteBBState.AbilityUses[line] = nil
				result67 = nil
			else
				net.Uses = net.Maximum
				result67 = net.Uses
			end
		end
	end

	local resourceName = flags.AbilityESPEnabled and vertexCount or nil
	angleRadians.Billboard.Enabled = resourceName ~= nil or flags.AbilityESPShowNames
	angleRadians.PlayerName.Text = line.DisplayName
	angleRadians.PlayerName.Visible = flags.AbilityESPShowNames and not features.Visuals.NativeNameVisible(radians, angleRadians.Billboard.Adornee)
	angleRadians.Label.Visible = resourceName ~= nil

	if resourceName then
		angleRadians.Label.Text = vertexCount .. (byte > 1 and " v" .. tostring(byte) or "")
		angleRadians.Icon.Visible = steering ~= nil

		if steering then
			angleRadians.Icon.Image = steering
		end

		angleRadians.Uses.Visible = result67 ~= nil

		if result67 ~= nil then
			angleRadians.Uses.Text = tostring(result67) .. " " .. (result67 == 1 and (result68 == "lives" and "life" or "use") or result68)
		end

		local net = flyteBBState.AbilityActive[line]

		if net and net.Ability == vertexCount and net.Ends > object then
			netStart = net.Start
			scalar = net.Duration
		elseif net then
			flyteBBState.AbilityActive[line] = nil
		end

		local magnitude = features.Visuals.GetCooldownDuration(line, vertexCount, byte)
		local lines = flyteBBState.AbilityCooldowns[line]
		local active = vertexCount == "Dribble" or vertexCount == "Dragon Spirit"
		local slider = active and flyteBBState.AbilityUses[line]
		local iteration = active and (slider and slider.Ability == vertexCount and slider.Expiration or 0)

		if not iteration then
			iteration = math.max(tonumber(line:GetAttribute("CooldownExpiration")) or 0, tonumber(radians:GetAttribute("CooldownExpiration")) or 0)
		end

		if cell and iteration > object then
			if not lines or lines.Ability ~= vertexCount or lines.Ends < iteration then
				lines = { Ability = vertexCount, Duration = magnitude > 0 and magnitude or iteration - object, Ends = iteration }
				flyteBBState.AbilityCooldowns[line] = lines
			end
		elseif active then
			flyteBBState.AbilityCooldowns[line] = nil
			lines = nil
		elseif not active and cell and magnitude > 0 and netStart > 0 and angleRadians.CooldownStart ~= netStart then
			angleRadians.CooldownStart = netStart
			lines = { Ability = vertexCount, Duration = magnitude, Ends = netStart + magnitude }
			flyteBBState.AbilityCooldowns[line] = lines
		end

		local difference = cell and lines and lines.Ability == vertexCount and math.max(lines.Ends - object, 0) or 0
		magnitude = lines and lines.Duration or magnitude

		if not major and difference > 0 and magnitude > 0 then
			local openError = math.max(1, angleRadians.Icon.AbsoluteSize.Y * math.clamp(difference / magnitude, 0, 1))
			angleRadians.Cooldown.Visible = true
			angleRadians.Cooldown.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, openError)
			angleRadians.CooldownText.Text = features.Visuals.FormatAbilityTime(difference)
			features.Visuals.SetCooldownText(angleRadians, true)
		else
			angleRadians.Cooldown.Visible = false
			features.Visuals.SetCooldownText(angleRadians, false)
		end

		local openError = scalar > 0 and math.clamp((object - netStart) / scalar, 0, 1) or 1

		if cell and not major and netStart > 0 and openError < 1 and vertexCount ~= "Rapture" and vertexCount ~= "Raging Deflection" and vertexCount ~= "Calming Deflection" then
			if angleRadians.DurationTween then
				angleRadians.DurationTween:Cancel()
				angleRadians.DurationTween = nil
			end

			angleRadians.DurationHolder.GroupTransparency = 0
			angleRadians.DurationHolder.Visible = true
			angleRadians.DurationText.Text = features.Visuals.FormatAbilityTime(scalar - object - netStart)

			if angleRadians.DurationStart ~= netStart or angleRadians.DurationTime ~= scalar then
				if angleRadians.DurationProgressTween then
					angleRadians.DurationProgressTween:Cancel()
				end

				angleRadians.DurationStart = netStart
				angleRadians.DurationTime = scalar
				angleRadians.Duration.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1 - openError, 0)
				angleRadians.DurationProgressTween = tweenService:Create(angleRadians.Duration, TweenInfo.new(scalar * (1 - openError), Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) })
				angleRadians.DurationProgressTween:Play()
			end
		else
			if angleRadians.DurationProgressTween then
				angleRadians.DurationProgressTween:Cancel()
				angleRadians.DurationProgressTween = nil
			end

			angleRadians.DurationStart = nil
			angleRadians.DurationTime = nil

			if angleRadians.DurationHolder.Visible then
				if not angleRadians.DurationTween then
					features.Visuals.HideDuration(angleRadians)
				end
			else
				angleRadians.Duration.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
				angleRadians.Duration.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
			end
		end
	else
		angleRadians.Icon.Visible = false
		angleRadians.Uses.Visible = false
		angleRadians.Cooldown.Visible = false
		angleRadians.CooldownText.Visible = false
		angleRadians.CooldownTextShown = false

		if angleRadians.CooldownTextTween then
			angleRadians.CooldownTextTween:Cancel()
		end

		angleRadians.CooldownTextTween = nil

		if angleRadians.DurationTween then
			angleRadians.DurationTween:Cancel()
		end

		if angleRadians.DurationProgressTween then
			angleRadians.DurationProgressTween:Cancel()
		end

		angleRadians.DurationTween = nil
		angleRadians.DurationProgressTween = nil
		angleRadians.DurationHolder.Visible = false
		angleRadians.DurationHolder.GroupTransparency = 0
		angleRadians.DurationStart = nil
		angleRadians.DurationTime = nil
	end
end

features.Visuals.RefreshESP = function()
	if not flags.AbilityESPEnabled and not flags.AbilityESPShowNames then
		return
	end
	local index51 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

	for _, particle in playersService:GetPlayers() do
		if particle ~= localPlayer then
			pcall(features.Visuals.RefreshPlayer, particle, index51)
		end
	end
end

features.Visuals.RefreshLoop = function()
	coroutineFunction("Ability ESP")
	if not flags.AbilityESPEnabled and not flags.AbilityESPShowNames then
		return
	end

	flyteBBState.Connections["Ability ESP"] = task.spawn(function()
			while flags.AbilityESPEnabled or flags.AbilityESPShowNames do
				features.Visuals.RefreshESP()
				task.wait(0.2)
			end
		end)
end

features.Visuals.ObserveCooldowns = function()
	local remoteEvent = replicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("ActivateAbility")

	if remoteEvent then
		flyteBBState.Connections["Ability Cooldown"] = remoteEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(line)
				features.Visuals.TrackCooldown(line)
			end)
	end

	local VoteRemoteEvent = replicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("PlrDragonSummonedEvent")

	if VoteRemoteEvent then
		flyteBBState.Connections["Dragon Spirit Uses"] = VoteRemoteEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(line)
				local hitPlayer = playersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(line)
				if not hitPlayer or hitPlayer == localPlayer or workspace:GetAttribute("GoldenAbilities") then
					return
				end
				local radians, angleRadians = features.Visuals.GetInfo(hitPlayer, line)

				if radians == "Dragon Spirit" then
					features.Detection.TrackAbilityUse(hitPlayer, line, radians, angleRadians + 1, features.Visuals.GetCooldownDuration(hitPlayer, radians, angleRadians))
				end
			end)
	end
end

					heartbeatUpdate("Triggerbot", line, "triggerbot mode")

			})

			uiElements.sliders.Triggerbot_MS = steering:AddSlider({
				Name = "Delay (MS)",
				SaveId = "Triggerbot_Delay",
				Min = 0,

		local function vectorAdd()
			local angleRadians = iterator:AddGroup({ Name = "Rendering", Side = "Left", Icon = "rbxassetid://10723427199" })
			uiElements.toggles.No_Render = angleRadians:AddToggle({ Name = "No Render", SaveId = "No_Render", Default = false, Callback = features.Render.DisableFX })
			uiElements.toggles.Anti_Lag = angleRadians:AddToggle({ Name = "Anti-Lag", SaveId = "Anti_Lag", Default = false, Callback = features.Render.SetAntiLag })

			local function targetFunction(line, object, descendant, radius, zCoordinate, alpha)
				if not setfflag or not getfflag then
					return false, 0
				end
				local dataTable = rawget(getgenv(), "FlyteFFlagDefaults")

				if type(dataTable) ~= "table" then
					dataTable = {}
					getgenv().FlyteFFlagDefaults = dataTable
				end

				local lines = {}
				local sourceTable = {}

				for vertex in pairs(line) do
					if type(vertex) == "string" and vertex ~= "" then
						local query = vertex:gsub("^D?F[FISL][a-z]*", "")
						local decoded, loadError = pcall(getfflag, query)

						if decoded and loadError ~= nil then
							lines[#lines + 1] = vertex
							sourceTable[vertex] = query

							if alpha ~= false and dataTable[query] == nil then
								dataTable[query] = loadError
							end
						else
							line[vertex] = nil
						end
					else
						line[vertex] = nil
					end
				end

				table.sort(lines)
				object = object or 10
				descendant = descendant or 0.07
				local difference = 0

				for k = 1, #lines, object do
					for column = k, math.min(k + object - 1, #lines) do
						local vertexCount = lines[column]
						local steering = line[vertexCount]
						local copyType = type(steering)
						local query

						if copyType == "number" then
							query = tostring(steering)
						elseif copyType == "boolean" then
							query = steering and "True" or "False"
						elseif copyType == "table" then
							query = httpService:JSONEncode(steering)
						elseif copyType == "string" then
							query = steering
						else
							query = nil
						end

						if query and pcall(setfflag, sourceTable[vertexCount], query) then
							difference += 1
						end
					end

					task.wait(descendant)
				end

				if difference <= 0 then
					return false, difference
				end

				if alpha == false then
					getgenv().FlyteFFlagsApplied = nil
				else
					getgenv().FlyteFFlagsApplied = true
				end

				queueonteleport(alpha == false and "getgenv().FlyteFFlagsApplied=nil;getgenv().FlyteFFlagDefaults=nil" or ("getgenv().FlyteFFlagsApplied=true;getgenv().FlyteFFlagDefaults=game:GetService('HttpService'):JSONDecode(%s)"):format(httpService:JSONEncode(httpService:JSONEncode(dataTable))))

				if zCoordinate then
					zCoordinate(difference)
				end

				task.wait(radius or 0.5)
				game.ExperienceService:LaunchExperience({ placeId = game.PlaceId })
				return true, difference
			end

			local function cleanup(line)
				local function createNode(object)
					local decoded, loadError = pcall(httpService.JSONDecode, httpService, object)
					local joint

					if decoded and type(loadError) == "string" then
						decoded, joint = pcall(httpService.JSONDecode, httpService, loadError)
					else
						joint = loadError
					end

					return decoded and type(joint) == "table" and joint or nil
				end

				local track = createNode(line)
				if track then
					return track
				end
				local lines = {}
				local difference = 1
				local openError = 1

				while difference <= #line do
					local rootFirst = line:find("\"", difference, true)

					if rootFirst then
						local characterIndex = line:find("%S", rootFirst + 1)
						local vertexCount = characterIndex and line:byte(characterIndex)

						if vertexCount ~= 91 and vertexCount ~= 123 then
							difference = rootFirst + 1
						else
							local steering = 0
							local cell = false
							local active = false
							local major = nil

							for k = characterIndex, #line do
								local byte = line:byte(k)

								if cell then
									if active then
										active = false
										major = nil
									elseif byte == 92 then
										active = true
										major = nil
									elseif byte ~= 34 then
										major = nil
									else
										cell = false
										major = nil
									end
								elseif byte == 28 then
									cell = true
									major = nil
								elseif byte == 91 or byte == 123 then
									steering += 1
									major = nil
								elseif byte == 93 or byte == 125 then
									steering -= 1

									if steering ~= 0 then
										major = nil
									else
										major = k
										break
									end
								else
									major = nil
								end
							end

							local dataString = major and line:find("%S", major + 1)
							local block = dataString and line:find("%S", dataString + 1)
							local byte = block and line:byte(block)
							local query = major and line:sub(characterIndex, major)
							local isArray = dataString and line:byte(dataString) == 34

							if isArray then
								isArray = not byte or byte == 44 or byte == 93 or byte == 125
							end

							if isArray and createNode(query) then
								lines[#lines + 1] = line:sub(openError, rootFirst - 1)
								lines[#lines + 1] = query
								difference = dataString + 1
								openError = difference
							else
								difference = rootFirst + 1
							end
						end

						continue
					end

					break
				end

				if #lines == 0 then
					return nil
				end
				lines[#lines + 1] = line:sub(openError)
				return (createNode(table.concat(lines)))
			end

			local function createNode(line)
				local targetName = tostring(line or ""):gsub("^\u{FEFF}", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
				if targetName == "" then
					window:Notify({ Title = "empty custom fflags" })
					return false
				end
				local track = cleanup(targetName)
				if not track then
					window:Notify({ Title = "invalid custom fflags json" })
					return false
				end

				local function generateRandomString()
					local jsonString = httpService:JSONEncode(track)
					local Selection = uiElements.textboxes.FFlags_Custom_Text

					if Selection then
						Selection:Set(jsonString)
					else
						flags.CustomFFlagsText = jsonString
					end
				end

				window:Notify({ Title = "Enabled", Duration = 1 })

				if not targetFunction(track, 60, 0.01, 0.04, function()
						generateRandomString()
						window:Notify({ Title = "Rejoining...", Duration = 1 })
					end) then
					generateRandomString()
					window:Notify({ Title = "no custom fflags applied" })
					return false
				end

				return true
			end

			local function subtractVectors(line, object, descendant)
				if descendant and descendant > 0 then
					tweenInstance(line, object, descendant, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
				else
					for vertex, modelName in pairs(object) do
						line[vertex] = modelName
					end
				end
			end

			local difference = 0

			local function crossProduct(line, object, descendant, radius, zCoordinate)
				local openError = object and 0 or 1
				local step = object and targetX or targetX + 8
				local mathMax

				if object then
					mathMax = radius and 26 or 21
				else
					mathMax = object
				end

				mathMax = mathMax or 0
				local forceField = radius and line.inputFrame or line.buttonFrame

				if line.Close then
					line:Close()
				end

				if object then
					if type(n28) ~= "function" or n28(2612) <= 505 then
						line.labelText.Visible = true
						forceField.Visible = true
					else
						while true do
						end
					end
				end

				subtractVectors(line.labelText, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, step), TextTransparency = openError }, descendant)

				subtractVectors(forceField, {
					Position = radius and UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, step + 22) or UDim2.new(1, forceField.Position.X.Offset, 0, step),
					Size = UDim2.new(0, forceField.Size.X.Offset, 0, mathMax),
					BackgroundTransparency = openError,
				}, descendant)

				if radius then
					subtractVectors(line.textbox, {
						TextTransparency = openError,
						PlaceholderColor3 = object and track.Library.config.Colors.SubText or track.Library.config.Colors.Secondary,
					}, descendant)
				else
					subtractVectors(line.selectedLabelText, { TextTransparency = openError }, descendant)
					subtractVectors(line.arrowImg, { ImageTransparency = openError }, descendant)
				end

				local vertexCount = forceField:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")

				if vertexCount then
					subtractVectors(vertexCount, { Transparency = openError }, descendant)
				end

				task.delay(descendant or 0, function()
						if object or zCoordinate ~= difference then
							return
						end
						line.labelText.Visible = false
						forceField.Visible = false
					end)
			end

			nearest = function(reason, line)
				difference += 1
				line = line and 0 or 0.34
				flags.CustomFFlags = reason
				track.elementYPos = targetX + (reason and 56 or 28)

				if track.UpdateSize then
					track.UpdateSize(line)
				end

				crossProduct(uiElements.dropdowns.FFlagsRegion, not reason, line, false, difference)
				crossProduct(uiElements.textboxes.FFlags_Custom_Text, reason, line, true, difference)
			end

			nearest(flags.CustomFFlags == true, true)
		end

			local nearestIndex = nil

			uiElements.dropdowns.Config_List = track:AddDropdown({
				Name = "Config List",
				SaveId = "Config_List",
				Options = Configs:Refresh(),
				Default = "none",
				NoSave = true,
				OnOpen = function()
					if nearestIndex then

				end,
				Callback = function(line)

				end,
			})

			nearestIndex = function()
				local lines = Configs:Refresh()

				if #lines == 0 then
					lines = { "none" }
				end

				uiElements.dropdowns.Config_List:Refresh(lines)

				if Configs.Selected and table.find(lines, Configs.Selected) then
					uiElements.dropdowns.Config_List:Set(Configs.Selected)
				else
					uiElements.dropdowns.Config_List:Set(lines[1])
				end
			end

			nearestIndex()
			local difference = (tonumber(track.elementYPos) or tonumber(track.mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y) or 0) + 2

			local function generateRandomString(line, object, descendant)
				window:Notify({ Title = line and object or "config failed: " .. tostring(descendant), Duration = 3 })
			end

			local function onHumanoidDied(line, object, descendant, radius)
				local mathMax = object == 1 and 10 or 135
				local leftChild = difference + ((tonumber(descendant) or 1) - 1) * 31

				local button = createInstance("TextButton", {
					Name = line:gsub("%s+", "_"),
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					BackgroundColor3 = track.Library.config.Colors.Element,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					FontFace = fontCache.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal),
					Text = line,
					TextColor3 = track.Library.config.Colors.SubText,
					TextSize = 13,
					Position = UDim2.new(0, mathMax, 0, leftChild),
					Size = UDim2.new(0, 113, 0, 25),
					Parent = track.mainFrame,
				})

				createInstance("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7), Parent = button })
				local vertexCount = createInstance("UIStroke", { Color = track.Library.config.Colors.BorderSoft, Parent = button })

				button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
						tweenInstance(button, {
						BackgroundColor3 = track.Library.config.Colors.ElementHover,
						TextColor3 = track.Library.config.Colors.Text,
					}, 0.2)

						tweenInstance(vertexCount, { Color = track.Library.config.Colors.Border }, 0.18)
					end)

				button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
						tweenInstance(button, {
						BackgroundColor3 = track.Library.config.Colors.Element,
						TextColor3 = track.Library.config.Colors.SubText,
					}, 0.22)

						tweenInstance(vertexCount, { Color = track.Library.config.Colors.BorderSoft }, 0.22)
					end)

				button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
						tweenInstance(button, {
						Size = UDim2.new(0, 113 - 5, 0, 25 - 2),
						Position = UDim2.new(0, mathMax + 2, 0, leftChild + 1),
					}, 0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
					end)

				button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
						tweenInstance(button, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 113, 0, 25), Position = UDim2.new(0, mathMax, 0, leftChild) }, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
						radius()
					end)
			end

			local function subtractVectors(line, object, descendant)
				return function()
					local playerUserId = Configs.Selected
					local vertexCount, steering = Configs[line](Configs, playerUserId)
					generateRandomString(vertexCount, object .. tostring(playerUserId), steering)

					if descendant then
						nearestIndex()
					end
				end
			end

			onHumanoidDied("Create", 1, 1, function()
					local query = uiElements.textboxes.ConfigName and uiElements.textboxes.ConfigName.value or ""
					local vertexCount, steering = Configs:Save(query)
					generateRandomString(vertexCount, "created config " .. tostring(Configs.Name(query) or query), steering)
					nearestIndex()
				end)

			local currentTime = subtractVectors("Load", "loaded config ")
			onHumanoidDied("Load", 2, 1, currentTime)
			local startTime = subtractVectors("Save", "overwrote config ", true)
			onHumanoidDied("Overwrite", 1, 2, startTime)
			local deltaTime = subtractVectors("Reset", "reset config ", true)
			onHumanoidDied("Reset Config", 2, 2, deltaTime)
			local errorMessage = subtractVectors("Delete", "deleted config ", true)

list2.playSfx = function(name)
	if not list2.sfxOn[name] then
		return
	end
	local str4 = list2.sfxId[name]
	if not str4 then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
		local fvlSFX = SoundService:FindFirstChild("FVLSFX")

		if not fvlSFX then
			fvlSFX = Instance.new("Folder")
			fvlSFX.Name = "FVLSFX"
			fvlSFX.Parent = SoundService
		end

		local sound = list2.sfx[name]

		if not sound or not sound.Parent then
			sound = fvlSFX:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("Sound")
			sound.Name = name
			sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. str4
			sound.Volume = list2.sfxVol[name] or 0.5
			sound.Parent = fvlSFX
			list2.sfx[name] = sound
		end

		sound.TimePosition = 0
		sound:Play()
	end)
end

local tab = obj3.Tab

obj3.Tab = function(self, param5)
	local value11 = tab(self, param5)

	if type(value11) == "table" and type(value11.Toggle) == "function" then
		local toggle = value11.Toggle

		value11.Toggle = function(param6, param7)
			if type(param7) == "table" then
				local callback = param7.Callback

				param7.Callback = function(...)
					if list2.sfxReady and not list2.sfxQuiet then
						list2.playSfx("toggle")
					end

					if callback then
						return callback(...)
					end
				end
			end

			return toggle(param6, param7)
		end
	end

	return value11
end

list2.mouseAimPoint = function()
	local currentCamera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not currentCamera then
		return nil
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local num1 = currentCamera:ViewportPointToRay(mouseLocation.X, mouseLocation.Y)
		local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
		raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LocalPlayer.Character }
		local hit = Workspace:Raycast(num1.Origin, num1.Direction * 300, raycastParams)
		return hit and hit.Position or num1.Origin + num1.Direction * 300
	end)

	return ok and result or nil
end

list2.xrayWas = {}

list2.setXray = function(xrayOn)
	list2.xrayOn = xrayOn

	if xrayOn then
		for _, descendant in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Transparency < 0.5 then
				local model = descendant:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")

				if not (model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)) then
					if list2.xrayWas[descendant] == nil then
						list2.xrayWas[descendant] = descendant.Transparency
					end

					descendant.Transparency = 0.5
				end
			end
		end
	else
		for k, value16 in next, list2.xrayWas, nil do
			pcall(function()
				if k.Parent then
					k.Transparency = value16
				end
			end)
		end

		list2.xrayWas = {}
	end
end

list2.copyText = function(param10)
	local genv = getgenv and getgenv() or _G

	for _, clipboardFn in ipairs(list2.CLIPBOARD_FNS) do
		local value19 = rawget(genv, clipboardFn)
		local result

		if type(value19) ~= "function" then
			local ok

			ok, result = pcall(function()
				return getfenv(0)[clipboardFn]
			end)

			if not (ok and type(result) == "function") then
				result = value19
			end
		else
			result = value19
		end

		if type(result) == "function" and pcall(result, param10) then
			return true
		end
	end

	local func9 = ipairs
	local tbl7 = { syn, "write_clipboard" }
	local tbl8 = { syn, "set_clipboard" }
	local tbl9 = { rawget(genv, "Clipboard"), "set" }
	local tbl10 = { rawget(genv, "Clipboard"), "Set" }
	local tbl11 = { tbl7, tbl8, tbl9, tbl10 }

	for _, value20 in func9(tbl11) do
		local first1 = value20[1]
		local second1 = value20[2]

		if type(first1) == "table" and type(rawget(first1, second1)) == "function" then
			if pcall(first1[second1], param10) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

				table.insert(tbl16, { obj = textButton3, prop = "TextTransparency", to = 0 })
				local uiScale3 = Instance.new("UIScale", textButton3)

				textButton3.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
					TweenService_:Create(uiScale3, TweenInfo.new(0.07), { Scale = 0.96 }):Play()
				end)

				textButton3.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
					TweenService_:Create(uiScale3, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
				end)

				local callback = action.callback

				func13(textButton3, function()
					TweenService_:Create(uiScale3, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Scale = 1 }):Play()

					if action.closes ~= false then
						func12()
					end

					if callback then
						task.spawn(callback)
					end
				end)
			end
		end

		local tweenInfo2 = TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local tweenInfo3 = TweenInfo.new(0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.52)
		TweenService_:Create(frame, tweenInfo3, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) }):Play()
		TweenService_:Create(uiScale, tweenInfo3, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
		TweenService_:Create(textButton, tweenInfo2, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 }):Play()
		TweenService_:Create(frame, tweenInfo2, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }):Play()
		TweenService_:Create(uiStroke, tweenInfo2, { Transparency = 0.42 }):Play()
		TweenService_:Create(frame2, tweenInfo2, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }):Play()
		TweenService_:Create(uiStroke2, tweenInfo2, { Transparency = 0.42 }):Play()
		TweenService_:Create(clone, tweenInfo2, { ImageTransparency = 0 }):Play()
		TweenService_:Create(textLabel, tweenInfo2, { TextTransparency = 0 }):Play()
		TweenService_:Create(textLabel2, tweenInfo2, { TextTransparency = 0 }):Play()
		TweenService_:Create(textLabel3, tweenInfo2, { TextTransparency = 0 }):Play()

		if imageLabel then
			TweenService_:Create(imageLabel, tweenInfo2, { ImageTransparency = 0.84 }):Play()
		end

		for _, item7 in ipairs(tbl16) do
			TweenService_:Create(item7.obj, tweenInfo2, { [item7.prop] = item7.to }):Play()
		end

		local timeout = tbl14.timeout or 25

		if timeout > 0 then
			task.delay(timeout, function()
				func12()
			end)
		end
	end)

	return func12
end

list2.inLobbyNow = function()
	local localPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
	localPlayer = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	localPlayer = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
	localPlayer = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Game")
	if not localPlayer then
		return true
	end
	return localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Inventory") == nil
end

list2.coinFails = {}
list2.coinSkips = {}

list2.coinSkip = function(param12)
	local flag17 = list2.coinSkips[param12]
	if not flag17 then
		return false
	end

	if flag17 < tick() then
		list2.coinSkips[param12] = nil
		list2.coinFails[param12] = nil
		return false
	end

	return true
end

list2.coinFailed = function(param13)
	local n = (list2.coinFails[param13] or 0) + 1
	list2.coinFails[param13] = n

	if n >= 2 then
		list2.coinSkips[param13] = tick() + 20
	end
end

list2.coinReset = function()
	local value25 = list2
	list2.coinFails = {}
	value25.coinSkips = {}
end

	if not (isfile and delfile) then
		return
	end

	if isfile("WindUI/FVLV2/config/fvl_hud.json") then
		if writefile and not isfile(list2.hudFile) then
			writefile(list2.hudFile, readfile("WindUI/FVLV2/config/fvl_hud.json"))
		end

		delfile("WindUI/FVLV2/config/fvl_hud.json")
	end

	if listfiles then
		for _, listfile in ipairs(listfiles("WindUI/FVLV2/config")) do
			local match = tostring(listfile):match("[^/\\]+$") or ""

			if match:match("^fvl_hud") then
				local match2 = match:match("^fvl_hud_(.+)%.json$")

				if match2 and writefile then
					pcall(function()
						writefile(list2.hudDir .. "/" .. match2 .. ".json", readfile(listfile))
					end)
				end

				pcall(function()
					delfile(listfile)
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end)

	ROLEBOX = { conns = {} }

		end

		table.insert(ROLEBOX.conns, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
			table.insert(ROLEBOX.conns, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(ROLEBOX.watch))
		end))
	end

	list2.tr.drop = function(param20)
		local flag28 = list2.tr.parts[param20]
		if not flag28 then
			return
		end
		list2.tr.parts[param20] = nil

		for _, value29 in pairs(flag28) do
			pcall(function()
				value29:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end

	list2.tr.step = function()
		local currentCamera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not currentCamera then
			return
		end
		local viewportSize = currentCamera.ViewportSize
		if viewportSize.X < 1 or viewportSize.Y < 1 then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()

		if now - list2.tr.roleAt > 0.5 then
			list2.tr.roleAt = now
			list2.tr.murd = func15()
			list2.tr.sher = func16()

			for k in pairs(list2.tr.parts) do
				if k.Parent == nil then
					list2.tr.drop(k)
				end
			end
		end

		local character = localPlayer.Character
		character = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local n2 = viewportSize.X * 0.5
		local y = viewportSize.Y
		local n3 = viewportSize.X * 0.5
		local n4 = viewportSize.Y * 0.5
		local n5 = math.min(viewportSize.X, viewportSize.Y) * 0.33
		local flag29 = list2.tr.any()

		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local flag30 = list2.tr.parts[player]
			local character2 = player ~= localPlayer and player.Character or nil
			local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			character2 = character2 and character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if flag29 and humanoidRootPart and character2 and character2.Health > 0 then
				flag30 = flag30 or list2.tr.slot(player)
			elseif flag30 then
				local lbl = flag30.lbl
				local arw = flag30.arw
				flag30.line.Visible = false
				lbl.Visible = false
				arw.Visible = false
				flag30 = nil
			end

			if flag30 then
				local value30 = list2.tr.colorOf(player)
				local value31, flag31 = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(humanoidRootPart.Position)
				local flag32 = value31.Z <= 0
				flag31 = flag31 and not flag32

				if list2.tr.lines and flag31 then
					local n6 = value31.X - n2
					local n7 = value31.Y - y
					flag30.line.BackgroundColor3 = value30
					flag30.line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, math.sqrt(n6 * n6 + n7 * n7))
					flag30.line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(n2 + n6 * 0.5, y + n7 * 0.5)
					flag30.line.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(n7, n6)) - 90
					flag30.line.Visible = true
				else
					flag30.line.Visible = false
				end

				if list2.tr.dist and flag31 then
					local magnitude = character and (humanoidRootPart.Position - character.Position).Magnitude or (humanoidRootPart.Position - currentCamera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
					local value32 = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(humanoidRootPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0))
					flag30.lbl.TextColor3 = value30
					flag30.lbl.Text = math.floor(magnitude + 0.5) .. "m"
					flag30.lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(value32.X, value32.Y)
					flag30.lbl.Visible = true
				else
					flag30.lbl.Visible = false
				end

				if list2.tr.arrows and not flag31 then
					local n6 = value31.X - n3
					local n7 = value31.Y - n4

					if flag32 then
						n6 = -n6
						n7 = -n7
					end

					local n8 = math.sqrt(n6 * n6 + n7 * n7)

					if n8 < 1 then
						n6 = 0
						n7 = -1

list2.populatedHop = function()
	if list2.hopping then
		return false
	end
	list2.hopping = true
	local ok, result = pcall(list2.hopAttempt)
	if ok and result then
		return true
	end
	list2.hopping = false

	obj2:Notify({
		Title = "Hop Failed",
		Content = ok and "The server would not let go. Trying again in a minute." or "Hop errored - trying again in a minute.",
		Duration = 4,
		Icon = "x",
	})

	return false
end

list2.stopFarmHopWatch = function()
	if list2.hopThread then
		pcall(task.cancel, list2.hopThread)
		list2.hopThread = nil
	end
end

list2.startFarmHopWatch = function()
	list2.stopFarmHopWatch()

	list2.hopThread = task.spawn(function()
		local n = 0

		while true do
			task.wait(3)
			if not list2.farmHopOn then
				n = 0
				continue
			end

			if not (#Players:GetPlayers() < list2.HOP_MIN_PLAYERS) then
				n = 0
				continue
			end
			n += 3
			if not (list2.HOP_GRACE <= n) then
				continue
			end
			local ok, result = pcall(list2.populatedHop)
			local flag39 = false

			if ok then
				flag39 = result and true or false
			end

			if not flag39 then
				task.wait(list2.HOP_RETRY)
				n = 0
				continue
			end

			break
		end
	end)
end

		end)

		if not ok then

		end

	end

	list2.startBox = function(param30, param31)
		if list2.boxRunning[param30] then
			return
		end
		list2.boxRunning[param30] = true

		task.spawn(function()
			local n4 = 0

			while list2.boxOn[param30] do
				local value76, num5 = list2.boxPrice(param30)
				local num6 = list2.boxFunds(value76)

				if num5 and num6 and num6 < num5 then
					if not list2.boxWaiting[param30] then
						list2.boxWaiting[param30] = true

						obj2:Notify({
							Title = param31,
							Content = "Waiting for " .. list2.comma(num5 - num6) .. " more " .. list2.curName(value76) .. ". It opens on its own once you can afford one.",
							Duration = 5,
							Icon = "clock",
						})
					end

					task.wait(5)
				else
					list2.boxWaiting[param30] = false
					local flag60, flag61 = list2.openBox(param30)

					if not flag60 then
						local flag62 = list2.boxFunds(value76)

						if num5 and flag62 and flag62 < num5 then
							task.wait(5)
						else
							list2.boxOn[param30] = false

							if list2.el.box and list2.el.box[param30] then
								list2.setToggle(list2.el.box[param30], false)
							end

							obj2:Notify({
								Title = param31,
								Content = (n4 > 0 and "Opened " .. n4 .. ", then stopped: " or "Nothing opened: ") .. (flag61 or "the server refused") .. ".",
								Duration = 6,
								Icon = "x",
							})

							break
						end
					else
						n4 += 1

						task.spawn(function()
							pcall(list2.whBox, flag60)
						end)

						task.wait(list2.SBOX_DELAY)
					end
				end
			end

			list2.boxRunning[param30] = false
			list2.boxWaiting[param30] = false
		end)
	end

	list2.settingsBlob = function()
		local elements = list2.config and list2.config.Elements

		local list5 = {}
		local n4 = 0

		for _, farmFlag in ipairs(list2.FARM_FLAGS) do
			local value77 = elements[farmFlag[1]]

			if type(value77) == "table" then
				list5[#list5 + 1] = { farmFlag[2], list2.flagText(farmFlag[1], value77) }

				if n4 < #farmFlag[2] then
					n4 = #farmFlag[2]
				end
			end
		end

		if #list5 == 0 then
			return "_unavailable_"
		end
		local tbl20 = {}

		for _, item14 in ipairs(list5) do
			local n5 = #tbl20 + 1
			local second2 = item14[2]
			tbl20[n5] = item14[1] .. string.rep(" ", n4 - #item14[1] + 2) .. second2
		end

		local str12 = "```\n" .. table.concat(tbl20, "\n") .. "\n```"

		if #str12 > 1000 then
			str12 = str12:sub(1, 986) .. "\n...\n```"
		end

		return str12
	end

	list2.setDiff = function(tbl22, list6)

				list7[#list7 + 1] = "**" .. tostring(tbl23[k] or k) .. "**  " .. tostring(tbl22[k]) .. "  ->  **" .. tostring(value79) .. "**"

		end

		table.sort(list7)
		return list7
	end

	list2.whQ = {}
	list2.whQBusy = false
	list2.whSentN = 0
	list2.whDropped = 0
	list2.whLastErr = nil
	list2.whBreak = false

	list2.whSend = function(param37)
		local request_ = syn and syn.request or request or http_request or http and http.request
		if not request_ then
			return false, "no request function", nil
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(request_, {
			Url = list2.whUrlNow(),
			Method = "POST",
			Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
			Body = param37,
		})

		if not ok then
			return false, "request failed", 5
		end
		local n4 = tonumber(type(result) == "table" and (result.StatusCode or result.Status) or nil) or 0
		if n4 == 204 or n4 == 200 or n4 == 0 and type(result) == "table" and result.Success == true then
			return true, tostring(n4), nil
		end

		if n4 == 429 then
			local flag67 = type(result) == "table"

			if flag67 then
				flag67 = tostring(result.Body or "")
			end

			return false, "429", math.min(60, (tonumber((flag67 or ""):match("\"retry_after\"%s*:%s*([%d%.]+)")) or 1) + 0.25)
		end

		if n4 >= 500 then
			return false, tostring(n4), 5
		end
		return false, tostring(n4), nil
	end

	list2.whPump = function()
		if list2.whQBusy then
			return
		end
		list2.whQBusy = true

		task.spawn(function()
			while #list2.whQ > 0 and list2.current() and not list2.whBreak do
				local value85 = list2.whQ[1]
				local value86, str14, value87 = list2.whSend(value85.body)

				if value86 then
					table.remove(list2.whQ, 1)
					list2.whSentN = list2.whSentN + 1
					list2.whLastErr = nil
					value85.ok = true
					value85.code = str14
					value85.done = true
					task.wait(0.35)
				elseif value87 then
					task.wait(value87)
				else
					table.remove(list2.whQ, 1)
					list2.whDropped = list2.whDropped + 1
					list2.whLastErr = str14
					value85.ok = false
					value85.code = str14
					value85.done = true

					if str14 == "401" or str14 == "403" or str14 == "404" then
						list2.whBreak = true

						obj2:Notify({
							Title = "Webhook Rejected",
							Content = "Discord answered " .. str14 .. ". The webhook was deleted or revoked, so sending has stopped. Paste a new one.",
							Duration = 10,
							Icon = "x",
						})
					end
				end
			end

			if list2.whBreak then
				for _, item15 in ipairs(list2.whQ) do
					item15.done = true
					item15.ok = false
					item15.code = "stopped"
				end

				list2.whDropped = list2.whDropped + #list2.whQ
				list2.whQ = {}
			end

			list2.whQBusy = false
		end)
	end

	list2.whPost = function(obj)
		if not list2.whReady() then
			return false, "no webhook set"
		end
		local localPlayer2 = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

		local tbl26 = {
			title = obj.title,
			description = obj.body,
			color = list2.CLR_LINE,
			timestamp = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
			author = {
				name = localPlayer2.Name .. "  (" .. localPlayer2.DisplayName .. ")",
				url = "https://www.roblox.com/users/" .. tostring(localPlayer2.UserId) .. "/profile",
				icon_url = list2.avatarUrl(),
			},
			footer = { text = tostring(game.JobId), icon_url = list2.markUrl() },
		}

		if obj.thumb then
			tbl26.thumbnail = { url = obj.thumb }
		end

		if list2.BANNER ~= "" then
			tbl26.image = { url = list2.BANNER }
		end

		if obj.fields and #obj.fields > 0 then
			tbl26.fields = obj.fields
		end

		local tbl27 = {
			username = "F$VL",
			avatar_url = list2.markUrl(),
			allowed_mentions = { parse = {} },
			embeds = { tbl26 },
		}

		if obj.ping then
			tbl27.content = "@everyone"
			tbl27.allowed_mentions = { parse = { "everyone" } }
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(tbl27)
		end)

		if not ok then
			return false, "could not encode the payload"
		end
		local tbl28 = { body = result, done = false }

		if #list2.whQ >= 40 then
			local value88 = table.remove(list2.whQ, 1)
			value88.done = true
			value88.ok = false
			value88.code = "dropped"
			list2.whDropped = list2.whDropped + 1
		end

		list2.whQ[#list2.whQ + 1] = tbl28
		list2.whPump()
		if not obj.wait then
			return true, "queued"
		end
		local now = os.clock()

		while not tbl28.done and os.clock() - now < 25 do
			task.wait(0.1)
		end

		if not tbl28.done then
			return false, "no answer from Discord"
		end
		return tbl28.ok, tbl28.code
	end

	list2.whReward = function(flag72, flag73, param39)
		if not list2.whReady() then
			return false, "no webhook set"
		end
		local str18 = tostring(flag72 or ""):gsub("^%s*[xX]%s*", "")
		local func64 = tonumber
		local str19 = str18:gsub("[^%d%.]", "")
		local str20 = func64(str19)

		if tostring(flag73 or "reward"):lower():find("shell", 1, true) then
			if not list2.readShells() and str20 and type(list2.shellsLeft) == "number" then
				list2.shellsLeft = list2.shellsLeft + str20
			end

			str20 = str20 and list2.comma(str20) or str18 ~= "" and str18 or "?"
			local list13 = {}
			local Received = list2.fld("Received", "+" .. str20 .. " Shells")
			local fld = list2.fld
			local str21 = list2.comma(list2.shellsLeft) .. " Shells"
			list13[1] = Received

			do
				local values = table.pack(fld("Balance", str21))
				table.move(values, 1, values.n, 2, list13)
			end

			if type(list2.shellsLeft) == "number" then
				local n4 = list2.SBOX_COST - list2.shellsLeft
				list13[#list13 + 1] = list2.fld("Next box", n4 > 0 and list2.comma(n4) .. " Shells left" or list2.comma(math.floor(list2.shellsLeft / list2.SBOX_COST)) .. " boxes ready")
			end

			return list2.whPost({
				title = utf8.char(128026) .. "  +" .. str20 .. " shells",
				thumb = list2.SHELL_IMG,
				fields = list2.pad3(list13),

list2.startVelTracker = function()
	if list2.velConn then
		return
	end

	list2.velConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()

		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local humanoidRootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not humanoidRootPart then
				list2.velTrack[player] = nil
			else
				local num13 = list2.velTrack[player]

				if not num13 then
					list2.velTrack[player] = { p = humanoidRootPart.Position, t = now, v = Vector3.zero }
				elseif now - num13.t >= 0.03 then
					num13.v = (humanoidRootPart.Position - num13.p) / (now - num13.t)
					num13.p = humanoidRootPart.Position
					num13.t = now
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

			list2.velConn:Disconnect()
		end)
	end

	list2.velConn = nil

end

list2.leadTime = function()
	local aimLead = tonumber(_G.__FVL_AIMLEAD) or list2.aimLead

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() / 1000
	end)

	local flag79 = ok and type(result) == "number" and result > 0 and result < 1
	local n3 = 0.04

	if flag79 then
		n3 = result
	end

	return math.clamp(n3 + aimLead, 0, 0.3)
end

list2.aimAt = function(obj, part3)
	local humanoid = obj.Character and obj.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local n3

	if humanoid and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then
		n3 = humanoid.MoveDirection.Unit * humanoid.WalkSpeed
	else
		n3 = part3.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero

		if n3.Magnitude < 0.5 then
			local flag80 = list2.velTrack[obj]

			if flag80 and flag80.v.Magnitude >= 0.5 then
				n3 = flag80.v
			end
		end
	end

	if n3.Magnitude < 0.5 then
		return part3.Position
	end
	local num14 = list2.leadTime()
	local n4 = part3.Position + Vector3.new(n3.X, 0, n3.Z) * num14
	local n5 = n4 - part3.Position

	if n5.Magnitude > 8 then
		n4 = part3.Position + n5.Unit * 8
	end

	_G.__FVL_AIM = { aim = n4, targetPos = part3.Position, vel = n3, lead = num14, t = os.clock() }
	return n4
end

	func73 = function()
		local value108, flag98 = func87()
		if value108 then
			obj2:Notify({ Title = "Gun Grabbed!", Content = "Got the gun!", Duration = 1.5, Icon = "check" })
			return
		end
		local value109 = next
		local children, value110 = Workspace:GetChildren()
		local flag99 = false

		for _, value111 in value109, children, value110 do
			if value111:FindFirstChild("CoinAreas") or value111:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") then
				flag99 = true
				break
			end
		end

		if flag98 == "nochar" then
			obj2:Notify({
				Title = "No Character",
				Content = "Nothing to grab with right now.",
				Duration = 2,
				Icon = "x",
			})
		elseif not flag99 then
			obj2:Notify({
				Title = "Not In A Round",
				Content = "The round is over, so the gun can't be picked up. Wait for the next one.",
				Duration = 3,
				Icon = "clock",
			})
		elseif flag98 == "nodrop" then
			obj2:Notify({
				Title = "No Gun Found!",
				Content = "No gun on the ground right now.",
				Duration = 1.5,
				Icon = "x",
			})
		else
			obj2:Notify({
				Title = "Couldn't Grab It",
				Content = "Found the gun but the pickup didn't land -- move closer and try again.",
				Duration = 2.5,
				Icon = "x",
			})
		end
	end

			return

		local n8 = math.clamp(param61, 0, 1) * 360

	num15.resetDesign = function(obj)
		num15.snapDesign(obj)
		local base = obj.base
		local uiCorner = obj.btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")

		if uiCorner then
			uiCorner.CornerRadius = base.corner
		end

		obj.btn.BackgroundColor3 = base.body
		obj.btn.ClipsDescendants = false
		obj.stroke.Thickness = base.strokeThk
		local plate = obj.plate
		local platePos = base.platePos
		obj.plate.Size = base.plateSize
		plate.Position = platePos
		obj.plate.BackgroundColor3 = obj.accent
		obj.icon.Size = base.iconSize
		obj.label.Visible = true
		local label = obj.label
		local labelPos = base.labelPos
		local labelSize = base.labelSize
		obj.label.Position = labelPos
		label.Size = labelSize
		obj.footer = 0
		num15.setNow(obj.btn, { BackgroundTransparency = num15.bgRest() })
		num15.setNow(obj.stroke, { Color = obj.accent, Transparency = obj.active and 0 or 0.15 })
		num15.setNow(obj.plate, { BackgroundTransparency = num15.plateT(obj.active, false) })
		num15.setNow(obj.plateStroke, { Transparency = obj.active and 0.15 or 0.55 })
		num15.setNow(obj.icon, { ImageColor3 = num15.glyphC(obj, obj.active) })
		num15.setNow(obj.label, { TextColor3 = num15.labelC(obj.active) })

		if obj.track then
			obj.track.Visible = false
		end

		if obj.fill then
			obj.fill.Visible = false
		end

		if obj.ring then
			obj.ring.Visible = false
		end

		if obj.arcs then
			num15.setRing(obj, 0)
		end
	end

		if flag105 and flag105.apply then
			pcall(flag105.apply, obj)
		end

		num15.setActive(obj.name, obj.active)
	end

	num15.startCooldown = function(param74, cdTotal, text)
		local flag114 = num15.parts[param74]
		if not flag114 or not flag114.label then
			return
		end
		flag114.cdUntil = os.clock() + cdTotal
		flag114.cdTotal = cdTotal
		num15.designSlide(flag114, cdTotal)
		if flag114.cdThread then
			return
		end
		local match = text:match("^[^\n]+") or text

		local function func100(flag115, param75, flag116)
			if not flag115 then
				return
			end
			TweenService:Create(flag115, TweenInfo.new(flag116 or 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), param75):Play()
		end

		func100(flag114.stroke, { Color = COOLDOWN_GREY })
		func100(flag114.plateStroke, { Color = COOLDOWN_GREY })
		func100(flag114.plate, { BackgroundColor3 = COOLDOWN_GREY })
		func100(flag114.icon, { ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(124, 124, 134) })
		func100(flag114.label, { TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(112, 112, 124) })

		flag114.cdThread = task.spawn(function()
			while true do
				local flag117 = num15.parts[param74]

				if not (not flag117 or not flag117.cdUntil) then
					local n8 = flag117.cdUntil - os.clock()

					if not (n8 <= 0) then
						flag117.label.Text = match .. "\n" .. string.format("%.1fs", n8)
						task.wait(0.05)
						continue
					end
				end

				break
			end

			local value116 = num15.parts[param74]

			if value116 then
				value116.cdUntil = nil
				value116.cdThread = nil
				num15.designSet(value116, 0)

				if value116.active then
					local designNow = num15.designNow and num15.designNow()

					if designNow and designNow.active then
						pcall(designNow.active, value116, true)
					end
				end

				if value116.label then
					value116.label.Text = text
				end

				func100(value116.stroke, { Color = value116.accent })
				func100(value116.plateStroke, { Color = value116.accent })
				func100(value116.plate, { BackgroundColor3 = value116.accent })
				func100(value116.icon, { ImageColor3 = num15.glyphC(value116, value116.active) })
				func100(value116.label, { TextColor3 = num15.labelC(value116.active) })
				func100(value116.plate, { BackgroundTransparency = num15.plateT(value116.active, false) })
			end
		end)
	end

	end

	num16 = {
		enabled = false,
		conn = nil,
		smooth = 1,
		part = "UpperTorso",
		murdererOnly = true,

		predictedPosition = function(part7)
			if not part7 then
				return nil
			end
			local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not humanoidRootPart then
				return part7.Position
			end
			return part7.Position + (part7.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero) * math.clamp((humanoidRootPart.Position - part7.Position).Magnitude / 1200 * num16.leadFactor, 0.01, 0.3)
		end,
		getPart = function(instance4)
			if not instance4 then
				return nil
			end
			return instance4:FindFirstChild(num16.part) or instance4:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or instance4:FindFirstChild("Torso") or instance4:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or instance4:FindFirstChild("Head")
		end,
		alive = function(player6)
			if not player6 or not player6.Character then
				return false
			end
			local humanoid = player6.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
		end,
		inFov = function(param78)
			if num16.fov >= 500 then
				return true
			end
			local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local value119, flag118 = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(param78)
			if not flag118 then
				return false
			end
			local n8 = currentCamera.ViewportSize / 2
			return (Vector2.new(value119.X, value119.Y) - n8).Magnitude <= num16.fov
		end,
		getTarget = function()
			local result12 = func15()

			if result12 and result12 ~= localPlayer and num16.alive(result12) then
				local flag119 = num16.getPart(result12.Character)

				if flag119 and num16.inFov(flag119.Position) then
					local flag120 = not num16.wallCheck

					if not flag120 then
						flag120 = func65(result12.Character, localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
					end

					if flag120 then
						return result12, flag119
					end
				end
			end

			if num16.murdererOnly then
				return nil, nil
			end
			local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local n8 = currentCamera.ViewportSize / 2
			local huge = math.huge
			local value120 = nil
			local value121 = nil

			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if player ~= localPlayer and num16.alive(player) then
					local value122 = num16.getPart(player.Character)

					if value122 then
						local value123, value124 = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(value122.Position)

						if value124 then
							local magnitude = (Vector2.new(value123.X, value123.Y) - n8).Magnitude

							if magnitude <= num16.fov and magnitude < huge then
								local flag121 = not num16.wallCheck
								local value125

								if flag121 then
									value125 = flag121
								else
									value125 = func65(player.Character, localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
								end

								if value125 then
									huge = magnitude
									value120 = player
									value121 = value122
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return value120, value121
		end,
	}

	local function func106()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		if not character then
			return nil
		end
		local knife = character:FindFirstChild("Knife")
		if knife then
			return knife, character
		end
		local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
		backpack = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife")
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if backpack and humanoid then
			humanoid:EquipTool(backpack)
			task.wait(0.1)
			local character2 = localPlayer.Character
			return character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("Knife"), character2
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function func108(list19, param81)

			character = localPlayer.Character

		end

		if not (knifeStabbed and handleTouched) then

		pcall(function()

		local n8 = 0

		for _, item28 in ipairs(list19) do

			if humanoidRootPart then
				pcall(function()
					handleTouched:FireServer(humanoidRootPart)
				end)

				n8 += 1
			end
		end

		return n8
	end

	end

	func76 = function(childName2)

list2.myRole = function()
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	remotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Extras")
	local getPlayerData = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("GetPlayerData")
	if not getPlayerData then
		return nil
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return getPlayerData:InvokeServer()
	end)

	if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local entry4 = result[localPlayer.Name]
	return entry4 and entry4.Role or nil
end

list2.godMode = function()
	if list2.godBusy then
		obj2:Notify({ Title = "God Mode", Content = "Already running.", Duration = 3, Icon = "clock" })
		return
	end
	local value132 = next
	local children, value133 = Workspace:GetChildren()
	local value134 = nil

	for _, value135 in value132, children, value133 do
		if value135:FindFirstChild("CoinAreas") or value135:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") then
			value134 = value135
		end
	end

	if not value134 then
		obj2:Notify({
			Title = "No Map Yet",
			Content = "Wait till the round starts, then try again.",
			Duration = 5,
			Icon = "clock",
		})

		return
	end

	obj6 = value134
	if not (localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then
		obj2:Notify({ Title = "God Mode", Content = "No character to reset.", Duration = 4, Icon = "x" })
		return
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local flag138 = list2.myRole()

		if flag138 == "Murderer" then
			obj2:Notify({
				Title = "Murderer",
				Content = "This only works for Innocent and Sheriff.",
				Duration = 6,

		end

		if flag138 == "Sheriff" then
			obj2:Popup({
				Title = "ARE YOU SURE YOU WANT TO LOSE UR GUN?",
				Icon = "shield",

				Buttons = {
					{
						Title = "Cancel",
						Variant = "Tertiary",
						Callback = function()
						end,
					},
					{
						Title = "Yes, do it",
						Variant = "Primary",
						Callback = function()
							list2.godRun()
						end,
					},
				},
			})

			return
		end

		list2.godRun()
	end)
end

list2.godRun = function()
	if list2.godBusy then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		obj2:Notify({ Title = "God Mode", Content = "No character to reset.", Duration = 4, Icon = "x" })
		return
	end
	list2.godBusy = true

	task.spawn(function()
		obj2:Notify({
			Title = "God Mode",
			Content = "Resetting, back on the map in a second...",
			Duration = 3,
			Icon = "shield",
		})

		pcall(function()
			humanoid.Health = 0
		end)

		task.wait(1)
		local now = tick()
		local flag139

		while true do
			flag139 = func47(localPlayer)

			if not flag139 then
				task.wait(0.2)
			end

			if not (flag139 or tick() - now > 10) then
				continue
			end
			break
		end

		if flag139 then
			pcall(list2.teleportHome)

			obj2:Notify({
				Title = "God Mode On!",
				Content = "You cannot pick up coins or the gun now.",
				Duration = 6,
				Icon = "shield",
			})
		else
			obj2:Notify({ Title = "God Mode", Content = "Respawn took too long - try again.", Duration = 5, Icon = "x" })
		end

		list2.godBusy = false
	end)
end

						end
					end
				end
			end)

			if n4 > 0 then
				return
			end
			RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		end
	end)
end

local func118

func118 = function(param83, imageColor3, imageTransparency, textColor3)
	imageTransparency = imageTransparency or 0.55

	for _, descendant in ipairs(obj3.UIElements.Main:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("TextLabel") and descendant.Text == param83 then
			local imageButton = descendant:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ImageButton")

			if imageButton then
				imageButton.ImageColor3 = imageColor3
				imageButton.ImageTransparency = imageTransparency

				imageButton:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageColor3"):Connect(function()
					if imageButton.ImageColor3 ~= imageColor3 then
						imageButton.ImageColor3 = imageColor3
					end
				end)

				imageButton:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageTransparency"):Connect(function()
					if imageButton.ImageTransparency > imageTransparency then
						imageButton.ImageTransparency = imageTransparency
					end
				end)

				if textColor3 then
					for _, descendant2 in ipairs(imageButton:GetDescendants()) do
						if descendant2:IsA("TextLabel") then
							descendant2.TextColor3 = textColor3

							descendant2:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextColor3"):Connect(function()
								if descendant2.TextColor3 ~= textColor3 then
									descendant2.TextColor3 = textColor3
								end
							end)
						elseif descendant2:IsA("ImageLabel") and descendant2.Size ~= UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0) then
							descendant2.ImageColor3 = textColor3

							descendant2:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageColor3"):Connect(function()
								if descendant2.ImageColor3 ~= textColor3 then
									descendant2.ImageColor3 = textColor3
								end
							end)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return
		end
	end
end

local func119

func119 = function(param84)
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return param84.ParagraphFrame.UIElements.Container
	end)

	if ok and typeof(result) == "Instance" then
		return result
	end
	return nil
end

local func120
local tbl46 = {}

func120 = function(imageColor3)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(obj3.UIElements.Main:GetDescendants()) do
		if not tbl46[descendant] and descendant.Name == "ToggleFrame" then
			local layer = descendant:FindFirstChild("Layer")

			if layer then
				tbl46[descendant] = true
				layer.ImageColor3 = imageColor3

				if not layer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGradient") then
					local uiGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
					uiGradient.Rotation = 115

					uiGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)),
					})

					uiGradient.Parent = layer
				end

				local frame = descendant:FindFirstChild("Frame")
				frame = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("Bar")
				frame = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("Highlight")
				local glass = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("Glass")

				if glass then
					glass.ImageColor3 = imageColor3

					glass:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageColor3"):Connect(function()
						if glass.ImageColor3 ~= imageColor3 then
							glass.ImageColor3 = imageColor3
						end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

	local function hudSavedOn(flag)
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			if isfile and readfile and isfile("WindUI/FVLV2/config/autosave.json") then
				return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile("WindUI/FVLV2/config/autosave.json"))
			end
		end)

		if ok and type(data) == "table" then
			local elements = type(data.__elements) == "table" and data.__elements or data
			local entry = elements[flag]

			if type(entry) == "table" and entry.value ~= nil then
				return entry.value and true or false
			elseif type(entry) == "boolean" then
				return entry
			end
		end

		return false
	end
